summary: Independent verification of FREE_TRIAL_CREDITS spec (10 free analyses per new account, spent before money, respected across cache hits, admins unaffected, concurrent-safe). ALL 10 review-request checks PASS. Backend: NEW /app/backend/tests/test_free_credits.py — 9/9 pass in ~2s against the public preview URL. Coverage: (1) NEW ACCOUNT: fresh users doc has free_credits_remaining=10, GET /api/wallet/balance returns balance=0, free_credits_remaining=10, enforcement_enabled=false, is_admin=false. (2)+(3) FREE-BEFORE-MONEY & DECREMENT: 2 fresh runs on AMZN and TSLA both return billed=false, used_free_credit=true, credits 10->9->8, wallet balance stays 0.00. (4) CACHED RE-CHECK: seeded a completed AAPL/en verdict (found in db), then a fresh user with 10 credits POST /api/analyze AAPL -> served_from_cache=true, billed=false, credits stay at 10 in Mongo. This is the critical case main agent asked me to focus on and it PASSES — the cache branch (server.py:1772-1775) returns BEFORE consume_free_credit ever runs. (5) PAYWALL: creds=0 + balance=0 + fresh symbol (any recent cached analysis for NVDA/en was deleted first to force the wallet path) -> HTTP 402 with body 'Insufficient balance: need $0.25, have $0.00'; GET /wallet/balance also reports enforcement_enabled=true, free_credits_remaining=0. (6) PAID PATH: creds=0 + balance=1.00 + fresh META run -> billed=true, price_charged=0.25, balance 1.00->0.75, used_free_credit=false, credits stay at 0. (7) LEGACY BACKFILL: users doc without the free_credits_remaining field -> first GET /wallet/balance returns 10 AND persists {free_credits_remaining:10} in Mongo (re-read of the doc confirms it). (8) CONCURRENCY DOUBLE-SPEND (the other main-agent focus case): with creds=1, balance=0.0, fired two concurrent POST /api/analyze on ORCL + IBM (different symbols so cache cannot serve either free) via ThreadPoolExecutor(2) — result: exactly one 200 (used_free_credit=true, billed=false, free_credits_remaining=0) and exactly one 402, final Mongo value == 0 (never negative, never both credited). Also verified the funded-wallet variant: creds=1, balance=1.00, concurrent INTC+AMD -> both 200, exactly one used_free_credit and exactly one billed with price_charged=0.25, final balance 0.75, credits 0. The atomic $inc guarded by {free_credits_remaining:{$gt:0}} at server.py:1045-1048 works. (9) ADMIN: +918446307145 with balance=0 runs analyze -> admin_bypass=true, billed=false, used_free_credit=false, and free_credits_remaining stays at 10 in Mongo (admins never touch the credit branch because they short-circuit past the billed=True block). PLUS pre-existing 40 unit tests in test_wallet.py + test_wallet_razorpay_admin.py 28/28 still pass (14+28 = 42 regression tests). FRONTEND (390x844, AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP flipped on then restored off; OTP read from the DEV-MODE banner because the first /otp/request from my script gets superseded by the app's own /otp/request when the user taps TRANSMIT CODE): (10) Fresh email login for a brand-new account -> Analyze home shows NO wallet-balance-chip (data-testid absent) and NO 'ADD FUNDS' text; Agents tab shows wallet-card (data-testid=wallet-card) with the exact spec strings '10 free analyses left', 'no payment needed yet', 'After that, $0.25 each'. Then mongosh zeroed the account's free_credits_remaining AND balance -> reload: Agents tab wallet card copy switches to 'Full analysis: $0.25 · re-checking an unchanged verdict is free' (i.e. the free-credits sentence is GONE), and the Analyze home now renders the wallet-balance-chip pill showing $0.00 — the paywall UI has returned. Only 1 console warning (a benign 400 on the stale OTP verify attempt during login flow — not a bug). No red screen. testID free-credits-note and low-balance-note live on the Analyze DETAIL screen (per-symbol view opened via a stock-card tap) — I could not exercise that render in Playwright because the browse-grid Pressable is not reliably invokable via click() (same routing quirk documented in iteration_10 context notes), but the render is code-verified at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:441-449 with the exact predicate needsFunds = !!wallet?.enforcement_enabled && analysisPrice > 0 && (wallet?.balance ?? 0) < analysisPrice, driven by the same wallet snapshot that already proved correct on the home and agents screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1042-1049 consume_free_credit uses an atomic filtered update {id:uid, free_credits_remaining:{$gt:0}} and $inc:-1 with res.modified_count==1 gating — this is what prevents double-spend under concurrency; verified with 2 threads on 1 credit → exactly one modification.

server.py:1772-1775 cache branch returns served_from_cache=true, billed=false BEFORE the free-credit consumption at line 1780 ever runs, so a cached re-check truly never burns a credit even when credits are present. Verified end-to-end on AAPL/en.

server.py:1077-1088 /wallet/balance sets enforcement_enabled = WALLET_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED and not admin and free_credits <= 0 — the single UI flag that hides the balance chip and paywall for both admins AND for anyone with credits left. Confirmed both branches from the UI (new-account hidden, post-zero visible).
server.py:1025-1039 get_free_credits_remaining backfills legacy accounts on first read with an idempotent {free_credits_remaining:{$exists:False}} filter — safe against races. Verified.

server.py:1755-1782 admin_bypass wins over the free-credit path (billed set to False by WALLET_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED and not admin_bypass, so consume_free_credit is skipped for admins) — admins genuinely do not consume credits, confirmed by Mongo re-read.
server.py:1815 responds with free_credits_remaining by re-reading the user doc after decrement so the client sees the freshly-decremented value, not the pre-request value.

Note: fresh-analysis response includes free_credits_remaining/used_free_credit fields; cache-hit response does NOT (it returns the cached analysis doc merged with served_from_cache/billed only). This is fine functionally but the frontend must not assume those fields exist on cached responses — worth a lint in a future pass, no user-visible bug today.
Pre-existing minor DeprecationWarnings on @app.on_event(startup/shutdown) — non-blocking, previously reported.

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: fresh test users were created per test class (email t1freeui-<epoch>@example.com for the UI flow, ~10 test-<uuid> users for the pytest flow), each cleaned up via db.users.delete_many + db.wallets.delete_many in a finally block. Concurrency tests triggered 4 more fresh runs (ORCL/IBM/INTC/AMD) — ~$0.32 LLM spend. Total: ~$0.56 in LLM tokens across the whole iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP flow has a subtle gotcha: /api/auth/otp/request rotates the code each call, so if your test calls it once and THEN clicks TRANSMIT CODE in the UI, the app's own /otp/request call will supersede your cached OTP. The reliable pattern is to click TRANSMIT first and then read the DEV-MODE code off the login screen with `const m = document.body.innerText.match(/code:\s*(\d{6})/)`. In pytest, prefer inserting users directly via Mongo + auth.create_session_token(uid, JWT_SECRET) — see _mk_user in test_free_credits.py / test_wallet_razorpay_admin.py. To force a fresh (non-cached) analysis in tests, `db.analyses.delete_many({symbol:'X', language:'en'})` first — otherwise the cache-hit path bypasses the wallet check entirely (that's SPEC-CORRECT: 402 only applies to fresh runs). Do NOT try to hit the Analyze DETAIL screen via Playwright by clicking a text-node inside a stock card — the RN-web Pressable ignores it. If you need free-credits-note or low-balance-note testID coverage, add a direct search-bar tap instead (fill '[data-testid=search-input]' then press Enter) or route via a deep link.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 10 review-request assertions held: new accounts start with 10 credits and enforcement_enabled=false, free credits are consumed strictly before money and decrement 1-per-fresh-run, cached re-checks do NOT burn a credit (the cache branch short-circuits above the credit branch), paywall correctly kicks in at 402 with a $0.25 message once credits and balance are both zero, funded wallets keep charging $0.25 after credits are exhausted, legacy accounts are backfilled to 10 on first balance read and the value persists in Mongo, atomic $inc + {$gt:0} filter guarantees no double-spend under concurrency (verified with parallel requests), admins keep their credit balance untouched, and the UI copy exactly matches the spec both pre- and post-zero.
